summary: IAMGOLD Corp filed a Form 6-K on May 6, 2026, reporting the results of its Annual General Meeting held on May 5, 2026. All director nominees were elected, KPMG was reappointed as auditor, and shareholders approved the share incentive plan and executive compensation. No special-situation event (merger, tender, spin-off, etc.) occurred. This is a routine shareholder meeting disclosure, not a special situation.
